target: Weekly realized intake visits at Phoenix 20 W. Jackson St. 24/7 respite center; aggregate posted extended-hour/overnight site visits is a secondary descriptive endpoint
scope: Retrospective chronological validation of realized visits only; not potential demand, geographic coverage, MCH throughput or health effects
discovery_disclosure: Before locking this protocol, official search/open snippets for 2026-09-14--20 were seen: aggregate visits 3459 and Jackson visits 2154. Other weekly values have not been machine-extracted for modeling. This is not a fully blinded or prospective validation.
week_inclusion: Complete seven-day reporting periods within 2026-05-04--2026-09-20. Exclude May 1--3 and Sept 21--30 partial/unequal weeks; never derive weekly visits by subtracting revised cumulative totals.
fit_rule: Fit nonnegative least squares once on train data. Select by validation MAE; complex model must improve validation MAE by at least 5% over the best simple baseline. Refit selected rule on train+validation before evaluating the locked test once.
forecast_information: Only previous observed counts and previous-week NOAA maximum-temperature summary enter primary forecasts. No contemporaneous test-week observed temperature, future actual visits or next-report cumulative totals enter prediction.
evaluation: absolute error for each held-out week
gain relative to last-week and last-four-weeks baselines
dependence: Successive weeks and sites share weather/network/recording practices. Four test weeks are not four independent experiments. No iid confidence interval or deployment guarantee will be claimed.
failure_action: If complex alternatives do not beat the baseline in development, select baseline. Preserve all model test errors as diagnostics without test-based reselection. If selected model fails on test, keep the failed validation visible and do not promote to validated planning demand.
missing_policy: Missing source values remain missing; no digitizing plots or imputing target counts. A gap invalidates lagged pairs; never treat a gap as the immediately preceding week. If fewer than required complete periods, report the limitation rather than move cutoff after seeing scores.
